recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core follow-up is appropriate; any remaining correction to older THO publication versions or backports should be handled in THO/UTG.
issue_request: FHIR-25623 was an Applied FHIR-core Security technical correction with a Persuasive resolution. It reported that CodeSystem ProvenanceParticipantType had the future date 2023-05-12T00:00:00+10:00 and requested that the date be fixed.
initial_application: No core commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-25623 was found. The old source/provenance/codesystem-provenance-agent-type.xml did contain the reported date, but 5c0494aacf deleted that CodeSystem during the UTG/THO terminology migration. Later related core commits switched the active participation-role-type value set to THO provenance-agent-type and set the active value set date to 2021-12-06T18:00:00+01:00.
additional_context: A March 2021 Zulip terminology thread specifically cited FHIR-25623 as a FHIR-core ticket against vocabulary now managed in terminology and directed it to the UTG process. December 2022 Security WG minutes also listed FHIR-25623 under THO-managed vocabulary. Current core source keeps Provenance in build scope and binds Provenance.agent.type to participation-role-type, whose source includes the THO provenance-agent-type value set; the CodeSystem itself is external.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No FHIR core source change was made because the authoritative CodeSystem is in THO/UTG, current THO JSON no longer has the exact original 2023-05-12T00:00:00+10:00 typo, and editing historical tools/history release snapshots would not be a current-spec source fix.

related_jiras.note: Updated participation-role-type to include the THO provenance-agent-type value set instead of the older FHIR-local provenance participant value set.
Later Provenance.agent.type value set cleanup that set the active participation-role-type date to 2021-12-06 and retained the THO provenance-agent-type include.
Prior AutoFHIR audit for a different ProvenanceParticipantType concept-definition issue, already represented on the combined branch as external to core.
